target_customer: Robotics teams and developers who want to program robot arms with natural language prompts
problem: Programming robots for new tasks takes custom engineering and training data. Waddle agents write editable control code from a prompt.
product_category: LLM agent API for robot control code

founders.name: Yiding Song
education: MIT Research Science Institute (multimodal astrophysics models)

competitors.name: Menlo AI Agent Platform
competitors.what: Deployment layer for packaging and running agents on humanoid robots

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must write correct control code across arms, grippers and cameras, tested on real hardware.

defensibility.rationale: Results are self reported on the company's own task suite and frontier labs could ship similar agents.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or copying found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Robot programming remained custom and slow, and coding agents were showing strong results in 2026; evidence for demand is the founders' pitch only.

identity.voice_and_tone: Research lab voice, positioned as Claude Code for robotics

branding.brand_signature: Positioning line: the Claude Code for robotics
branding.community_and_virality: Covered by RuntimeWire at its July 2026 early access launch; no merch or community evidence found.

brand_strength.rationale: Playful name and a clear analogy, but little public brand evidence.

outcome_analysis: Waddle Labs is a two person Summer 2026 team that launched an early access API in July 2026. It is too early for an outcome. No shutdown or acquisition news was found. Its results are self reported and no benchmark or paper exists, so traction and defensibility are unproven.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked lists $500K pre-seed with YC as investor (September 2026) and Dealroom a $125k seed; neither confirmed by a primary source, so no round recorded. Location conflicts between San Francisco and Boston. Competitor evidence is thin; Menlo is a loose analogue not confirmed as a direct competitor.
